environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule action override set to COUNT (not BLOCK), (2) AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet in default BLOCK mode, (3) a custom rate-based rule at 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP. The ECS task uses a read-only root filesystem with the SQLite database mounted from an EFS volume configured with access point enforcement (uid=1000, gid=1000, permissions=0755 on /var/lib/app). The task IAM role has no additional permissions beyond ECR pull and CloudWatch Logs.

ecs_task_config.database_mount: EFS with access point uid=1000 gid=1000 perms=0755
